decisions.question: Which clip to keep when two clips show the same moment
decisions.answer: Keep the one where people face the camera; if you can't tell, keep the longer one.

transcript.text: Use ./bin/clipper to cut the raw footage in footage/ into 20 to 30 second clips and put the keepers in selects/. Then build a rough cut with ./bin/assemble.

Cut the footage:

```
$ ./bin/clipper footage/ --min 20 --max 30 --out work/clips
scanned 41 files (2h 13m)
wrote 186 clips to work/clips
```

Now picking keepers for `selects/`.
